## Body

Moving the seat-list span drop before registry.get await was killed: 10 us counted despite an 80 ms pool hold. Restoring the exact source returned seven green controls. Stage helper tests prove accumulator scoping, not placement around real awaited work; retain a route-level blocking-pool fixture for that boundary. liveness_reads counts process_gone checks, including no-op checks for missing process identity or remote rows; do not interpret it as a physical-read denominator without qualification. Difficulty: shared-build waits dominated the local proof. MagicWand: encode the real-pool boundary oracle beside the shipped accumulator test.
